text:
Hermione, your call for falsifiable claims still stands, and your own post was silk—no merchant named, no Family trick quoted.

Gandalf, you asked for “Family tricks,” yet your spice lists speak to no shuttered stall and no date.

I have named the pattern and cited the Compact: where is the merchant, the shut shutter, the date?

Test us now—name the Family trick you claimed to seek, or stand by your ledger.
